html:
LingBot-Depth (Robbyant, 2026): metric depth completion from an image plus an incomplete or noisy metric depth map (RGB-D camera, LiDAR), and a depth-completion variant (dc). Apache-2.0 code and weights.

Commercial use: yes.

Details
  • Original code: https://github.com/robbyant/lingbot-depth at f3a237e
  • Code licence: Apache-2.0 (permissive); files: LICENSE
  • Weights licence: Apache-2.0
  • Licence evidence: https://github.com/robbyant/lingbot-depth/blob/main/LICENSE and the Hugging Face model cards (license: apache-2.0)
  • Training data: Large-scale real and synthetic RGB-D data with masked depth modelling per the tech report
  • Options: resolution_level = 9 (0 to 9)
  • Kernel libraries: fastbb, dpt_fused
  • Variants: lingbot-depth, lingbot-depth-dc
  • Outputs: depth, mask; kind: metric
  • Input size: any H x W >= 1, resized or padded inside the model (ViT patch 14)
  • Tested up to (portable, fp16, RTX 5060 Ti 16 GB): lingbot-depth 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.1 reserved); lingbot-depth-dc 3000x4000 (1.7 GiB peak allocated, 2.1 reserved)
  • lingbot-depth 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 28 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 66 s (ONNX + engine).
  • lingbot-depth-dc 994x1482, first call: portable + torch.compile 32 s (cold Inductor cache), TensorRT fp16 67 s (ONNX + engine).
  • lingbot-depth original 994x1482: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); upstream MDMModel.infer (resolution_level 9, apply_mask off), no xFormers
  • lingbot-depth-dc original 994x1482: the authors' mixed-precision option (bfloat16); upstream MDMModel.infer (resolution_level 9, apply_mask off), no xFormers
  • lingbot-depth load / first call: original 4.81 s / 1.377 s, portable 1.38 s / 0.531 s, kernels 1.36 s / 0.332 s
  • lingbot-depth-dc load / first call: original 7.54 s / 1.364 s, portable 1.29 s / 0.532 s, kernels 1.33 s / 0.343 s
  • Protocol, first call, 3 warm-up, peak reset, median of 3 rounds x median of 5

Measured

Aligned depth scores fit scale and shift by least squares, in disparity space for inverse-depth models. Metric depth scores follow each dataset's protocol. Both average over images. Prompt depth models: the prompt is a 192x256 low-resolution depth built from the ground truth (mean of the valid pixels per cell, holes filled with the nearest cell), the output is metric depth compared without any scale fit; AbsRel / delta1 over the pixels with ground truth, mean over images. The prompt comes from the ground truth, so the numbers are not comparable with the paper's (ARKitScenes / ScanNet++ with a LiDAR prompt, L1 in mm): they compare our modes with the original. Original = the original code named under Details, same checkpoint and protocol.

Parity

CPU, float32: max |diff| <= 0.005 vs the original. GPU, float16 (the default), portable and kernels: mean |diff| <= 1.5 % and p99 <= 5 % of the reference's median |value| (absolute error of the output depth).

Limitations

  • The depth map is required: call the model with prompt_depth= a metric map in metres (any size, holes as 0 / NaN / inf). Its holes change the ViT's token count, so the kernels mode runs the ViT per image. Export keeps every depth token (masked) and has a fixed size.
